Name: Non-Gendered Flower Dance
Author: comfemshep
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/juanpa98ar]juanpa98ar[/url] created a fantastic Mod to change the Flower Dance and now I tested out making some assets for it! This mod adds sprites for all* the Flower Dance participants so they can dance in either row (Top or Bottom). The game decides both their position and partner randomly although some pairings are more likely.

[size=1]*I haven't yet added the sprites for Harvey so he will always dance in the bottom row.[/size]

I have set the mod so Haley always dances in the top row because I thought it fit but you can change this in the Code if you want. I've added the Sprites for her to dance on the Bottom too.


[b]Installation:[/b]

A) No Seasonal Outfits Installed
-> Just dowload this mod (and its requirements) and put it into your Mod folder

B) Seasonal Outfits Installed
-> Same as above but you're going to need to install the Optional File: "Seasonal Cute Characters Compatibility", drag it into your Mod folder and let it overwrite the files there.
Note that the Portraits and Sprites won't match up since I didn't make any changes to the Seasonal Outfit Portraits, just the Sprites.

If you're using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30727]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url] you can add the Optional File: "talkohlooey 1oxnes Portraits". The portraits will then match the sprites. (If you already have my Portrait and Sprite change mod installed you don't need to do this step)




Credits:
The base for the [b]code[/b] is by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/juanpa98ar]juanpa98ar[/url]
The [b]sprites[/b] (or bases for the sprites) are all either from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url] or my modified versions of their sprites with adjustments made to make them dance.
